text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer!
Let's go enjoy some 'bad luck' together!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"This morning at the shoe lockers, Fuku-chan told me:
'An ominous sign! Go pray at the shrine!'"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it sound fun, kind of like a game!
That's why—
(Rustle, rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's that, a kitty?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's Rice-chan~!
What's up? Are you squatting down looking at ants?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No...
I came to pray, but... um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-No... I just don't want to get in the way.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: When Rice is around... Rice brings bad luck, so maybe it's better if Rice stays in the corner...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Even this morning... because she walked to school with Rice,
Urara-chan's shoelace... ugh."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! It just snapped
all of a sudden, out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I was like, "Why is that!? This is so fun!"
and got super excited!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Inter... esting...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's go pray at the shrine together!
I'm sure it'll be fun! Right, Trainer?âª
choice_data_list: As long as you're okay with it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...!
Y-Yes! I'll... give it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I hope something fun happens!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't let... anything bad...
happen to Urara-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And that wraps up the shrine visit!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Ooh! My body feels kinda lighter somehow!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whew... Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Rice-chan!
Visiting the shrine together was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...No, Rice is the one who should be thanking you.
Thank you... for inviting me."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I don't really get it, but
you're welcome!

Thanks to the shrine visit,
both the slump and her friend's worries were resolved.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! We've still got plenty of time!
What should I do next, I wonder~?
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? That sound is...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The button on my shoe popped off!
It's flapping open, this is fun♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's... it's all Rice's fault...!
I'm so, so sorrryyyy!

The buckle on her shoe broke for some reason, but
Haru Urara didn't care in the slightest and kept frolicking around.
